about.mission: Our mission is to deliver stress-free, transparent, premium healthcare to every pet and their family.

faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Call us — we'll explain clearly.

hours.a: Mon–Sat 10:00–18:00, closed Sunday. For urgent cases during working hours, call 050 355 17 17.

walkin.q: Can I walk in without an appointment?
walkin.a: Yes, we accept walk-ins on a queue basis. To minimise waiting, we recommend booking online or by phone.

home.a: Yes — routine exams, vaccination, blood draws, and pets that stress during travel, within a 50 km radius.

passport.q: Do you issue an international pet passport?
passport.a: Yes. We are a licensed clinic that issues pet passports and takes FAVN samples for EU travel.

animals.a: Dogs, cats, rabbits, hamsters, birds, and small exotics. Farm animals by arrangement.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Cash, Visa/MasterCard, bank transfer, and mobile payments. Instalments available for major procedures.

emergency.q: What should I do in an emergency?
emergency.a: Call 050 355 17 17 immediately. During working hours our on-call vet responds to critical calls.

price.a: Starting prices are listed on the site. The final amount is confirmed after the doctor's assessment — no hidden fees.

english.a: Yes. Our English-speaking veterinarians handle everything from checkups to emergency surgery.

parking.a: Yes, convenient parking near the clinic. Message us on WhatsApp for directions.
